title_zh: 明确公共服务台的转介范围

scenario.label_zh: 确认公共服务台的转介范围
scenario.goal_zh: 区分庇护和公民身份问题的转介渠道，并约定志愿者只提供预约与联系方式

context_zh: 虚构公民服务中心培训中，新志愿者核对服务台职责；不解释任何国家的法律资格。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: At the civic help desk, will I answer questions about asylum as well as citizenship?

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: You'll help people reach the right adviser. The two topics have separate appointment lists here.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: So if someone asks whether they're eligible, I shouldn't try to interpret the rules?

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: Exactly. Give them the relevant service's contact details or help arrange an appointment. Let the qualified adviser address their situation.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: I'll use the referral sheet, then, and keep my explanation to how they can contact the service.

sentences.speaker: George
sentences.text: That's right. If you aren't sure which list fits, ask me rather than guess.

targets.sense_zh: 公民事务的；市民服务的
